name: from-claude
description: Continue, in this conversation, a task that was being worked on in Claude Code. The first time it imports and links the Claude session; after that it only brings over new progress. Use when the user says $from-claude, "continue from claude", "import the … session from claude", "sync with claude", "what did claude get done", 接着 claude 继续, 从 claude 把…导入, or shares a screenshot of a Claude session and asks to continue it.

findings.excerpt: This skill uses the `ccx` command from the ccx app (github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx). If `~/.local/bin/ccx` doesn't exist, tell the user to install ccx with `curl
